Pinned image: task/tests/Dockerfile (sha256 72998ab8...) is byte-identical to the template tests/Dockerfile; bases node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim (tag-pinned, same as template; no digest, template-controlled), npm pins @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (lines 16-22), pip harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 (line 31), Chromium installed from the pinned Playwright MCP's bundled playwright CLI (lines 33-39); verifier copies its own /tests (line 43) with chmod go-rwx. tests/test.sh, tests/tools/ and tests/.dockerignore are identical to the template; test.sh lines 63-64 only check REWARDKIT_JUDGE/REWARDKIT_MODEL are set and never override them. Judge files: all five judge.toml [judge] blocks contain judge = "claude-code" (expected fallback) and no model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight key; the only 'model' mentions are comments (lines 2-4) pointing to [verifier.env]. Functional judge.toml mode='individual'/timeout=550 differs from template but is outside this row (timeouts/mode are row 11 scope). Broken-app probe: wiring is task-level config independent of app behavior, so no broken app can exploit it. Conforming-alternative probe: no app choice changes judge/model/credential routing. Limit: no full configured verifier launch/grading is recorded (raw-evidence-index scope says full configured grading is absent; the golden script ran in cw-editor-verifier:current, not a fresh build of this task's verifier image), so actual ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY} resolution and model availability are unmeasured; that runtime gap belongs to the pipeline's full-verifier-launch record, not to this source-config row, which Harbor/template wiring satisfies.
